subject: Kickoff: ArtVLM attribute recognition for catalog enrichment
body:
Team,

Starting the ArtVLM workstream. The pitch: our prefix language modeling approach to attribute recognition can auto-tag product and image catalogs with fine-grained attributes (color, material, state) far better than the classifier zoo we run today.

Plan for the quarter: stand up training on VGARank, which extends Visual Genome with attribute_prompts (object fixed, attribute varied) and object_prompts (attribute fixed, object varied) at the bounding-box instance level. That ranking formulation is exactly what we need for catalog-scale scoring.

Milestones: data loaders and baselines by 5/1, VGARank-Attribute eval readout by mid-June, launch review in July before window close on 7/27.

Daniela, can you confirm allocations this week? Csilla and Kaia lead modeling, Vera the scoring/eval path, Saoirse the ingestion side.

Dmitri
